citation: Official Record of the Old Settlers' Society of Racine County, Wisconsin, Raymond settlement account.
locator: Elisha Raymond Sr. and son Alvin came on the Agnes Barton to Chicago and then to Racine before settling Raymond on September 22, 1835
note: Retrospective old-settlers record. The rare Elisha Raymond name and documented Chicago transit make a useful candidate for the printed 'Rayond Elisha', but the dated Chicago passage is September 1835, after the July 1 scene date, so the identity remains unasserted.
